summary: Most requested changes appear implemented: new 13x5 grid-based chart editor UI with per-column adjustments, localStorage persistence for grid charts, and frontend Callaway calculation updated to support fractional worst-holes deductions. One potentially unrequested backend change (adding a migration module) is present, and some backend/lookup details are truncated so cannot be fully verified from the diff summary alone.

hallucinated_features.description: Added backend state migration module even though a state upgrade necessity is not evidenced in the diff summary (constraint said to add only if strictly required).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest allows adding backend/migration.mo only if strictly required for state upgrade, but the diff shows a placeholder migration returning empty state with no demonstrated need.
evidence: backend/main.mo (imports Migration "migration" and uses "with migration = Migration.run")
